SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001029
DOCKET NO. F00540922
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB, AS OWNER TRUSTEE OF THE RESIDENTIAL CREDIT OPPORTUNITIES TRUST X-B
DEFENDANTS- ERIK RODRIGUEZ; TARA RODRIGUEZ; COUNTY OF MIDDLESEX; LVNV FUNDING LLC; CITIBANK, N.A.; STATE OF NEW JERSEY; UNITED STATED OF AMERICA
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 17th DAY OF June 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of ROSELLE, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 19 BLOCK 6204
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
334 JOHN STREET ROSELLE, NJ 07203
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Our File No. 20021-1588/1dd
All that certain land and premises situated in the Borough of Roselle, County of Union, State of New Jersey, being more particularly described as follows:
Property Occupancy: Owner Occupied
on the Tax Map of the Borough of Roselle
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 37.50ft to the nearest cross street known as 4th
Avenue
Approximate Dimensions: 110.15ft x 38.27ft x 117.79ft x 37.50ft
Being more commonly known as:
334 John Street
Roselle, New Jersey 07203
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Union County in Deed Book 6166, at Page 0871
APPROXIMATE UPSET AMOUNT IS $350,610.29 FOR THE SHERIFF SALE
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated April 23, 2026.
Subject to: 2026 2nd quarter taxes due 5/1/2026, $3,196.88 OPEN
2026 Yd quarter taxes due 8/1/2026, TO BE DETERMINED
Sewer: Included with Taxes
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
4914-9936-6555, v, 1
HILL WALLACK LLP
ATi'ORNEYS AT LAW
Page 3
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding surplus, if any.
4914-9936-6555, v, 1
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $324,795.69 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: May 22, 2026
HILL WALLACK LLP
21 ROSZEL ROAD
PRINCETON, NJ 08543-5226
